facts.text: Western Oregon University operates on an academic calendar consisting of three terms or quarters during the regular academic year.

sources.title: Tuition and Fees » Estimated Cost of Attendance
sources.quote: The regular academic year consists of three terms or quarters. The estimated cost of education below is for undergraduate students for the academic year (9 months) paying the Basic tuition rate.

facts.text: Western Oregon University was founded in 1856 in Monmouth and is the state of Oregon's oldest public university.

sources.title: The Write Place moves to Western Oregon University
sources.quote: Western Oregon University, founded in 1856 in Monmouth, is the state's oldest public university.
